Item: Astro Boy: THE BRAVE IN SPACE
Creator: Tezuka Osamu
Studio: Tezuka Productions Co., Ltd.; Mushi Production
Subject: Modernity,Humanism
Description: A pioneering Japanese animated series directed by Osamu Tezuka. It served as a profound spiritual totem for Edward Yang, inspiring both his humanistic worldview and the naming of his independent production company, 'Atom Films'. It symbolizes his lifelong pursuit of marrying technological rationality with artistic creation.
